caption:
The average card rate is a little lower than it was. 💳

Bankrate puts it at 19.71% as of Nov 4, down from the record 20.79% in Aug 2024.

Still, on a $5,000 balance that's roughly $985 a year in interest if you carry it.

Did you notice your own rate change this year?
first_comment: Do you know your card's APR off the top of your head? 👇
